import sys

def mod_pow(base, exp, mod=1000000007):
    res = 1
    base %= mod
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    if k == 0:
        print(mod_pow(p, p - 1))
        return
    
    if k == 1:
        print(mod_pow(p, p))
        return
    
    order = 1
    cur = k % p
    while cur != 1:
        cur = (cur * k) % p
        order += 1
    
    print(mod_pow(p, (p - 1) // order))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
